# How to Adjust Audio Pitch with Claude MCP and Medux

A Claude MCP and Medux tutorial for changing audio pitch, creating higher and lower pitch versions, uploading files with curl, polling tasks, and downloading MP3 results.

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_shift_audio_pitch`

## Prompt

```text
project/ └── sample-audio.m4a The workflowDescribe the taskCreate upload URLUpload audioRun two pitch shiftsDownload results 01Describe both pitch changes in one promptAsk Claude to use Medux and specify the exact change for each output. In the tutorial, the source file is shifted up by 100% and down by 50%.Use Medux to modify the pitch of sample-audio.m4a. Create two outputs: - Increase pitch by 100% (2× frequency / +12 semitones) - Decrease pitch by 50% (0.5× frequency / −12 semitones) Upload the file with curl when needed.
```

## Review before approval

- Every local file or attachment maps to the intended Medux file or asset ID.
- The proposed tool names match the live Medux MCP schema.
- Operation order, output settings, and cost-relevant options match the request.

## Claude notes

- In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, attach inputs and enable the Medux connector for the conversation.
- In Claude Code, keep inputs in the working directory and confirm Medux with `/mcp`.
- An attachment is not a Medux `file_id`; approve the upload step when the workflow requires one.
